propositions: Plan-review attestations must record signed material fingerprints for direct children and prerequisites to detect when related plans change materially.
Pin validity enforcement must invalidate downstream reviews only when intermediate material actually drifts, not transitively across the entire dependency graph.
Execution-phase reviews must apply a fixed 0.80 priority floor to blocking-threshold resolution while keeping advisory criteria visible and lower findings reportable.
Close operations must verify compatible plan-review phase and pin status under the global write lock before committing STATUS, unless bypassed by force-close with reason.
Legacy attestations without pins and older readers that ignore unknown manifest lines must remain valid and interoperable without re-signing or migration.
Pre-sign collection must abort and retry if concurrent changes alter ticket relationships or material fingerprints, with atomic re-verification under the store write lock before signing.
